testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and cancels opening a recent part with options: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:388:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and cancels opening a recent part with options ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Part26.opd from the disposable package is displayed in List View with a Front design-view name ✔ And no recent-document checkboxes are selected ✔ When the user opens the part row's actions menu ✔ And the user chooses Open with options ✔ Then a File Open Options dialog is displayed ✔ And Model State shows the primary state ✔ And Design View shows Last Active ✔ When the user opens the Design View list ✔ Then the list includes the primary view and the Front view ✔ When the user chooses Front ✔ Then Design View shows Front ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes and the Recent list is visible
